Orbit.

Interactive prototype

A little space to focus. A distraction-free timer for one thing at a time.

ONE THING AT A TIME 25:00

Take a breath. Start when you’re ready.

THE IDEA

A quieter kind of productivity.

Most productivity tools ask you to manage the tool before you can do the work. Orbit explores the opposite: one task, one timer, and just enough structure to begin.

Choose something small and give it your attention for 25 minutes. The prototype below keeps everything in your browser. There are no accounts, dashboards, or streaks to maintain.
